content.rationale: The write interface (S2-write, `pnpsmvpz`) writes node documents to the working copy; this is the module that realizes it, holding no read reach and reaching no runner. It names the document through S2-path's single derivation (`pumpuqkv`), `nodes/<id>.json`, the same one the read calls, rather than by a private literal, under the root it takes from the shared root holder (`ppwnzwwy`) (S2-write-under-root, `nkqpvozu`), and places it whole (S2-write-whole, `wznzyssk`): the bytes it is given are the document's complete contents, a replacement and never an append, never a patch in place. It lands them by the shared atomic rule (`rmmlokop`): a temporary in the document's own directory, a sibling that is not a node document, written and flushed and renamed over the document. A write that cannot be completed leaves the document as it was and no temporary behind (S2-write-fail, `tkwuyxux`), the cause carried as a value; the module refuses nothing and renders nothing (S2-write-refusal-site, `myoztqyu`). It never creates the document's directory. The id reaches it already checked (S2-id, `wpxrlzuy`), so naming stays total and it validates nothing. M-layout (`szmuyqrq`) places the module flat at src/store_write.rs.
